messages:
Priya M: hi team — quick Q. we finalized adoption of my son in India. carrier docs require birth cert + translated copy + apostille. embassy said apostille timeframe is ~4 weeks. placement date is 2026-02-28. open enrollment is coming but this is a QLE. can i add him now or wait for apostille?
Erin (People Ops): congrats Priya!! for international adoption it's a valid QLE. carriers usually accept a domestic birth cert + notarized translation + proof of adoption filing while apostille is pending. upload what you have and note "apostille pending". we'll request exception for the apostille timeline. :partyparrot:
Priya M: great. i have the original foreign birth cert (scanned), a certified english translation, and the adoption decree. SSN is not assigned yet; we applied at the embassy. will the lack of SSN block the enrollment?
Sam (Benefits Admin): carriers accept "SSN pending" if you upload proof of SSN application (or embassy receipt) plus the adoption decree/translation. we can provisionally add dependent with coverage effective back to placement date (2026-02-28) if within carrier retro window. if SSN arrives later, upload to finalize.
Jon (Payroll): payroll note: additions must be filed in Workday before the payroll snapshot — next snapshot is 2026-03-20 11:59pm PT. if docs miss that snapshot, we can still retro-enroll to 2026-02-28 but premiums will be reconciled on next payroll cycle. please include the placement date in the Workday notes.
Priya M: what's the exact Workday flow? any preferred file names?
Erin (People Ops): Workday > Benefits > Add Dependent (QLE). upload files named: foreign_birthcert_priya, translation_priya, adoption_decree_priya, ssn_receipt_priya (if available). in the comments put: "International adoption QLE — placement 2026-02-28 — apostille pending". i'll tag benefits for expedited review.
BenefitsBot: Reminder: max upload 25MB. For sensitive PII, you can email people-ops-secure@redwood.com with subject line "secure upload - <your name>" for SFTP intake.
Sam (Benefits Admin): i'll provisionally approve once adoption decree + translation + ssn receipt (or embassy letter) are uploaded. if apostille comes later, attach it and note the case id. we'll keep coverage effective retro to placement date.
Priya M: thanks all. one more — if apostille ends up being >60 days, is there a hard cutoff where carrier denies retro?
Sam (Benefits Admin): carriers vary; many allow up to 90 days for international adoptions but we treat >60 days as "requires escalation". if you foresee >60 days, ping me and Erin and we'll file an exception with the carrier along with embassy correspondence.
Jon (Payroll): and tag me in the Workday case for the retro premium calc (@Jon). i'll prepare draft reconciliation tables in case.
Priya M: uploaded translation_priya.pdf and adoption_decree_priya.pdf. thanks everyone :pray:
